formal_role: Specifies what is minimized or maximized
systems_modeling_role: Determines what the optimization treats as success
review_warning: Optimization results inherit omissions and value choices in the objective

systems_modeling_role: Represents resource capacity conservation legal policy or ethical limits
review_warning: Hidden constraints can make a formal optimum infeasible in practice

formal_role: Set of allowed states satisfying constraints
systems_modeling_role: Restricts decision space to implementable or admissible options
review_warning: Feasible region depends on assumptions and boundary definitions

formal_role: Balances objective and constraint gradients at candidate optima
systems_modeling_role: Supports local shadow-value and tradeoff interpretation
review_warning: Multiplier meaning depends on units scaling and local validity

formal_role: Identifies active inactive violated or near-active constraints
systems_modeling_role: Shows which boundaries shape feasible improvement
review_warning: Inactive constraints may become active under uncertainty or scenario change

systems_modeling_role: Supports diagnostic review of candidate solutions
review_warning: Small residual does not guarantee global optimality
